tickets.subject: Charged twice for invoice INV-20431
tickets.body: Hello, our card was charged twice for invoice INV-20431 ($49.00) on November 18. Please fix the duplicate payment and send the extra $49.00 back to us.

tickets.subject: CSV export fails with error E-502
tickets.body: Since this morning every CSV export of our shipment report fails with error E-502 after about ten seconds. Smaller exports fail too, and our dispatch team cannot plan today's routes without it.

tickets.subject: How do I make a teammate an admin?
tickets.body: We hired a new office manager. How can I give her admin rights on our workspace so she can invite people and manage roles? She already signs in as a normal user.

tickets.subject: Payment page keeps spinning
tickets.body: When I try to update our card on the payment page it keeps spinning and then shows a blank page. I am not sure whether the new card was saved or whether we were charged again.
